title: Chronic Hypertension & GDM in Pregnancy
keywords: CHAP trial treat mild chronic HTN target < 140/90
sources: Critical Vector — OB Pocket Guide: HTN & GDM in Pregnancy (CHAP / ACOG 2024)
Tita AT et al. NEJM 2022 (CHAP); ACOG Practice Bulletins on chronic hypertension and gestational diabetes

changelog.change: Initial entry — CHAP-era BP threshold/target and agents, aspirin prophylaxis, GDM diagnostic criteria + glucose targets + delivery timing.

summary: Since CHAP (2022), mild chronic hypertension in pregnancy is treated to a target below 140/90 — this reduces adverse perinatal outcomes without fetal growth harm. Start low-dose aspirin before 16 weeks in anyone with a preeclampsia risk factor.

rows: SBP ≥ 140 or DBP ≥ 90 mmHg (sustained) — CHAP standard of care
SBP 110–139 / DBP 70–89 mmHg (avoid over-treatment / uteroplacental hypoperfusion)
Labetalol; extended-release nifedipine; methyldopa. AVOID ACE inhibitors, ARBs, direct renin inhibitors, and spironolactone
81–150 mg/day started before 16 weeks (100–150 mg has the stronger evidence) for any moderate/high preeclampsia risk factor
37–38+6 wk if well controlled on no/low medication; earlier for superimposed preeclampsia, poor control, or fetal compromise

items: Two-step (common in the US): 1-h 50 g glucose challenge — ≥ 140 mg/dL (some use ≥ 130) → 3-h 100 g GTT. Carpenter-Coustan thresholds (≥ 2 abnormal): fasting 95, 1 h 180, 2 h 155, 3 h 140 mg/dL.
One-step (IADPSG): 75 g 2-h OGTT — any single value at or above fasting 92, 1 h 180, 2 h 153 mg/dL.

rows: Insulin is first-line (NPH + regular, or basal-bolus). Metformin/glyburide cross the placenta — shared decision
Diet-controlled (A1): 40–41 wk. Medication-requiring, well controlled (A2): 39–40 wk. Poor control: individualise, earlier
75 g 2-h OGTT at 4–12 weeks (lifetime type 2 diabetes risk ~ 50%)

body.text: In labor with pregestational or insulin-requiring GDM, run an insulin/dextrose protocol to keep maternal glucose ~ 70–110 mg/dL — maternal hyperglycaemia drives neonatal hypoglycaemia. Anticipate shoulder dystocia with an estimated fetal weight ≥ 4500 g (offer cesarean) and ≥ 4000 g with GDM.
